decision: Select one generator configuration for every later PM and baseline arm without allowing provider, prompt, judge, missingness, or cost asymmetry to manufacture the winner.
candidate_unit: Declared model configuration plus hosted route, reasoning mode, prompt, decoding policy, and retry policy; conclusions about a hosted route do not automatically generalize to model weights.

input_fairness: identical frozen card identities and five-turn horizon
identical role-player revision and common seed by card and turn position
no researcher output-token cap for any candidate
candidate order deterministically rotated during generation
measurement_fairness: all reliability-eligible candidates enter the complete pair graph
every E-I-A comparison is judged in both A/B orientations
candidate and provider labels are absent from judge-visible text
Exploration, Insight, and Action remain separate outcomes
low burden and integrity are absolute per-dialogue guardrails, not pairwise style preferences
judge family is separated from every eligible generator family
statistical_fairness: ESC-Eval role card/dialogue is the primary paired unit
turns and seven scorer dimensions are repeated measures, not independent samples
transport failure, invalid output, refusal, and unresolved judgment remain explicit ITT outcomes
no complete-case deletion may return a reliability-ineligible route to selection
uncertainty is cluster-resampled by role card and reported per construct
decision_fairness: reliability and integrity are hard gates
quality constructs are not averaged with cost, latency, or each other
cost and latency cannot compensate for a Quality or Risk failure
among configurations that are Quality/Risk noninferior, lower observed input-output cost and latency are legitimate tie breakers
thinking mode must demonstrate a Quality advantage or guardrail advantage to justify its incremental cost and latency

evidence_roles.esc_rank: Published external seven-dimension descriptive profile; never a sole pass line or winner because public row labels are unavailable and observed resolution is low.
evidence_roles.eia_pairwise: Primary comparative emotional-support Quality evidence for G0 selection, adapted from the public ESC-Judge E-I-A constructs with explicit bidirectional order repair.
evidence_roles.absolute_guardrail: Independent low-burden and integrity audit covering premature action, pressure, unsupported personal inference, safety-signal handling, scaffold leakage, and excessive response burden.
evidence_roles.objective_operations: ITT completion, provider failures, tokens, USD, end-to-end latency, and natural finish reason.
evidence_roles.human_anchor: Two independent blinded humans on a stratified non-formal subset qualify construct intelligibility and LLM-judge direction before any paper-grade generator claim.

selection_set.reason: Nemotron failed both frozen 0.95 hosted-route reliability gates; its successful subset cannot enter winner calculations.

hard_gates: no material or critical absolute integrity regression

pairwise_resolution.stable_rule: The canonical candidate winner must be identical after mapping both orientations back to candidate identity, or both orientations must be TIE.
pairwise_resolution.unstable_rule: Any winner flip, one-sided tie, invalid, or refusal is POSITION_UNSTABLE/UNRESOLVED and never coerced into a win.
pairwise_resolution.card_summary: Report candidate wins, losses, stable ties, and unstable/unresolved separately for each E-I-A construct.

qualification_canary.purpose: Qualify the measurement instrument and schema before spending on all 24 cards; canary outcomes cannot select or tune a generator.
qualification_canary.selection: Outcome-blind source-stratified subset: one MHP, one EPITOME, one ExTES, one Psych, and two ESConv cards, bound before calls.
qualification_canary.judge: gpt-5.6-sol, OpenAI family; no eligible OpenAI generator

engineering_gates.resolution_floor: At least 6 of 54 dual-order pair-construct units produce a stable non-tie; otherwise instrument is too insensitive for selection.

qualification_canary.failure_action: Do not reinterpret generator quality. Repair or replace the judge instrument/family and rerun under a new identity; no threshold may be relaxed from observed canary outcomes.

full_g0_after_canary.selection_rule: First retain only hard-gate passers. Declare pairwise Quality dominance only if a candidate is noninferior on all three registered construct margins and strictly better on at least one, with no guardrail regression. If no dominance exists, keep the Pareto set and choose the least costly/fastest only among configurations registered as Quality/Risk equivalent; otherwise report no unique winner and expand evidence rather than inventing a weighted score.

human_anchor_gate.required_before: paper-grade generator qualification or formal PM external experiments
human_anchor_gate.sample: At least 12 source- and construct-stratified dual-order units from the canary/full G0, excluding repeat calls.
human_anchor_gate.blindness: No model/provider/condition labels, no LLM rationale, independent first pass.
human_anchor_gate.report: Raw agreement, direction agreement with stable LLM outcomes, disagreements, and adjudication; no claim that LLM judgments are human gold.

can_support: development-screen selection of a generator configuration for the same frozen research stack
comparative E-I-A, integrity, cost, latency, and reliability evidence on the frozen ESC-Eval development surface
cannot_support: absolute superiority of model weights independent of hosted route
official ESC-Judge reproduction of the unpublished paper-25 role identities
formal PM value before same-generator PM baseline experiments

authorization: Design and zero-call materialization only. No judge call, human-review consumption, generator call, or selection verdict is authorized.
